fuel_consumption.source_quote: Jet fuel consumption decreased 7.1% principally reflecting decreased flight operations after September 11, 2001. FY2001 consumption estimated from FY2002 statistical table (1,381 million gallons shown for prior year).

instrument_type_details.notes: As of December 31, 2001, no fuel hedges in place. In February 2002, purchased out-of-the-money call options to hedge approximately 35% of projected 2002 fuel requirements for March-December. Previously had $329M notional petroleum call options at Dec 31, 2000 (now expired/settled).

warnings: No fuel hedges outstanding at December 31, 2001; company entered new hedges in February 2002 for 35% of 2002 requirements.
